{{Vanilla|Lapis Lazuli Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Quartz Deposit''' is the renamed lapis lazuli ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
The vanilla lapis feature, changed to 12 attempts per chunk (vanilla 2) between y=−32 and y=96.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/placed_feature/ore_lapis.json}}</ref> Where it replaces deepslate it places [[Natural Lapis Lazuli|natural lapis lazuli]] instead.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 2–5 [[Quartz|quartz]]; adamant tools drop glass. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/lapis_ore.json}}</ref>
